query: Old black and white wartime romance, a cynical American runs a nightclub in Morocco and his ex-lover walks in with her resistance-leader husband needing travel papers. Ends at the airport in fog. 'Play it again' is a misquote from it.
a woman steals money from her boss, checks into a lonely motel run by a shy young man and gets killed in the shower. the 'mother' in the house is not what you think. hitchcock, black and white.

Slow sci-fi film with apes touching a black monolith, then astronauts on a ship to Jupiter where the computer HAL refuses to open the pod bay doors. Trippy ending with a giant space baby. Late 60s Kubrick.

Mafia family saga in New York, the youngest son who didn't want the family business ends up as the new don. Horse head in the bed, 'an offer he can't refuse'. Marlon Brando. The first one, not part II.

a giant great white shark attacks swimmers at a summer beach town, the mayor won't close the beaches, and three men go out on a small boat to hunt it. 'gonna need a bigger boat'. Spielberg, 70s. I think it was set in Florida.

a small-time boxer from Philadelphia who collects debts for a loan shark gets a random shot at the heavyweight champion. drinks raw eggs and runs up the museum steps. 'Adrian!'. he loses on points, i think. Not Creed.

Lonely insomniac Vietnam veteran drives a cab at night in New York, gets a mohawk and tries to rescue a 12 year old prostitute. 'are you talking to me' in the mirror. Robert De Niro or maybe Al Pacino.
Farm boy on a desert planet finds a message from a princess hidden in a robot, joins an old knight and a smuggler to blow up a giant space station. 1977, the very first one, not the prequels.

Crew of a space cargo ship answers a distress signal, a creature bursts out of a crewman's chest during dinner. Only the woman officer and the cat survive. Late 70s sci-fi horror. Not the James Cameron sequel.

A writer takes a job as winter caretaker of an isolated mountain hotel with his wife and son, goes insane and chases them with an axe. Twin girls in the corridor, 'here's johnny'. Stephen King book but Kubrick's film.
A lonely boy hides a stranded alien in his closet, they ride a bicycle flying across the moon, and the alien wants to phone home. Reese's Pieces. Early 80s Spielberg.
Detective in a rainy futuristic Los Angeles hunts down human-like androids, the villain gives a speech about tears in rain before dying. Harrison Ford. Is he an android too? The original, not 2049.

a cyborg assassin from the future is sent back to kill a waitress whose unborn son will lead humans against the machines. 'I'll be back'. Arnold is the bad guy in this one. mid 80s. not the second one.

a teenager accidentally travels back to the 60s i think in a time machine car built by a crazy scientist, and his own mother falls in love with him. needs lightning hitting a clock tower to get back. 88 miles per hour.

Eight year old boy is accidentally left behind when his big family flies to Paris for Christmas, he defends the house from two burglars with crazy traps. Early 90s comedy. The first one in Chicago, not the New York sequel.
Based on a real gangster who becomes an informant, his life in the mob from a kid to witness protection. 'Funny how? Funny like a clown?' Scorsese, Ray Liotta. Not Casino.

A young FBI trainee interviews a brilliant cannibal psychiatrist in prison to catch a serial killer who skins women. Fava beans and chianti. Early 90s, won all the big Oscars. I think it was Anthony Hopkins and Meryl Streep.

The robot from the first film comes back as a protector of the teenage boy, against a newer liquid-metal shape-shifting killer posing as a cop. 'Hasta la vista, baby'. Thumbs up as he sinks into molten steel.

Billionaire builds a theme park with cloned dinosaurs on an island, the power fails during a storm and a T-rex escapes. Water rippling in a cup, raptors in the kitchen. 90s Spielberg. Not Jurassic World.

Grumpy TV weatherman gets stuck reliving the same day over and over in a small town at a festival about a rodent predicting winter. He tries everything, even dying, until he becomes a better person. Bill Murray.
Black and white Holocaust film about a German businessman who saves over a thousand Jewish workers by employing them in his factory. The little girl in a red coat. Spielberg, 90s.

banker wrongly convicted of killing his wife spends nearly 20 years in prison, befriends a guy who can get things, and escapes through a tunnel hidden behind a poster. ends on a beach in mexico. based on stephen king. what is the name of this film?? driving me crazy
Nonlinear crime film with hitmen talking about burgers in Paris, a dance contest with the boss's wife, an adrenaline shot to the heart, and a mysterious glowing briefcase. Tarantino, mid 90s.
Slow-witted kind man from Alabama accidentally takes part in major historical events, runs across America, says life is like a box of chocolates. Shrimp boat business. Tom Hanks.
Animated film where a lion cub's uncle kills his father in a stampede and blames the cub, he runs away and grows up with a meerkat and a warthog. 'hakuna matata'. Disney 1994, not the 2019 remake.
two detectives, one about to retire, hunt a serial killer whose murders follow the seven deadly sins. rainy city. the ending with the box in the desert. brad pitt, morgan freeman. 90s.

First fully computer-animated movie: a cowboy toy gets jealous when a space ranger action figure becomes the boy's favourite, and they get lost at the house of the neighbour kid who tortures toys. Mid 90s Pixar.

Poor artist wins a ticket on a luxury ship and falls for a rich engaged girl, he draws her wearing only a diamond necklace, the ship hits an iceberg and sinks. She lets him freeze while she floats on a door. Late 90s.

A janitor at MIT is secretly a math genius who solves an impossible problem on a blackboard, but he's troubled and goes to a therapist who keeps saying it's not your fault. Robin Williams. Written by its two young stars.
World War II film that opens with a brutal D-Day beach landing, then a captain and his squad are sent to find one private whose brothers were all killed. Tom Hanks. Spielberg, late 90s.

a man discovers his whole life is a reality TV show filmed in a giant dome, his wife and best friend are actors. he sails a boat until he hits the painted sky wall. jim carrey but not really a comedy.
Hacker learns the world is a computer simulation run by machines, takes a red pill, learns kung fu by download and dodges bullets in slow motion. Keanu Reeves. Late 90s.

An insomniac office worker meets a soap salesman and they start an underground fighting club that turns into an anarchist movement. Huge twist that they're the same person. Brad Pitt and Edward Norton. First rule: you don't talk about it.
child psychologist tries to help a boy who says 'i see dead people', and the twist is that the psychologist himself has been dead all along. bruce willis. m night shyamalan.
Roman general's family is murdered by the jealous new emperor, he becomes a slave gladiator and fights his way to the Colosseum for revenge. 'are you not entertained?'. Russell Crowe, 2000.
a man with short-term memory loss tattoos clues on his body and uses polaroids to find his wife's killer, and the story is told backwards. early Christopher Nolan. Not the Indian remake with Aamir.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
query: A hobbit inherits a magical ring and sets out with a wizard, an elf, a dwarf and men to destroy it. The wizard falls fighting a fire demon on a bridge saying 'you shall not pass'. The first film of the trilogy.

Animated: an overprotective clownfish dad crosses the ocean to find his son, who was taken by a diver to a dentist's aquarium in Sydney, helped by a forgetful blue fish. Turtles surfing the current. Pixar.

film: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
query: After a bad breakup, a couple each undergo a procedure to erase each other from their memories, and he changes his mind halfway and tries to hide her in his childhood memories. Jim Carrey, not a comedy at all, Kate Winslet with blue hair.

Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London obsessively try to outdo each other's teleportation trick, one uses a machine built by Tesla that makes copies. The twist involves twins. Christian Bale and Hugh Jackman, Nolan.

the joker terrorizes gotham, a district attorney becomes two-face, the ferry social experiment with bombs, and a hospital blows up while the villain walks out in a nurse's dress. heath ledger. Nolan's second batman.

A paralysed marine controls a blue alien body on a moon called Pandora, falls for a native princess and fights the humans mining near her people's sacred tree. 3D, James Cameron, 2009. Not The Way of Water.
A team of thieves enters people's dreams to plant an idea, dreams within dreams, a hotel corridor fight in zero gravity, and a spinning top at the end. Leonardo DiCaprio. 2010.
Story of a Harvard student who creates a social networking website and gets sued by his best friend and twin rowers. Told through lawsuits and depositions. Fincher, Jesse Eisenberg.

astronaut leaves his daughter on a dying earth full of dust storms to find a new planet through a wormhole, one hour on a water planet with giant waves is 7 years on earth, he talks to her through a bookshelf in a tesseract. matthew mcconaughey.

Musical romance in Los Angeles between a jazz pianist and an aspiring actress, they dance at sunset on a hill and at an observatory. Bittersweet what-if ending. Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone. The Oscar envelope mix-up.

A Black photographer visits his white girlfriend's rich liberal family for a weekend and discovers they hypnotize Black people with a teacup and send them to the sunken place to transplant brains. Horror with satire. Jordan Peele.

superheroes travel back in time to collect the infinity stones and undo the snap that wiped out half the universe. the big final battle with all of them, iron man snaps his fingers and dies. 2019. not infinity war.

A failed stand-up comedian with a laughing disorder in Gotham becomes a violent criminal, dancing on stairs in a red suit, and kills a talk show host live on TV. Joaquin Phoenix. Not a superhero movie.

Biopic of the physicist who led the atomic bomb project at Los Alamos, the Trinity test explosion, and his security clearance hearing afterwards. Parts are in black and white. Cillian Murphy, Christopher Nolan, 2023.
